decisions.reason: Although it was developed further on the website in 2019, a vegan superfood drink mix sits less naturally with the firm's core waste-to-resource and engineering knowledge, so even with strong R&D the firm is likely to reallocate resources to more related technologies.

Modular waste-to-energy plant extensions are strongly aligned with the firm's established technical base and can benefit from its in-house R&D, prototyping and university links, so management would usually continue them despite only modest website prominence.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant is clearly within the firm's core knowledge domain and received sustained standalone presentation after launch, which makes it a strong candidate to retain and improve through learning.

A plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's established offer and gained a dedicated page by 2019, so the firm's absorptive capacity and growth orientation make continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.
